lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns on the lateral flank posterior to the gills, transitioning from a dense cluster near the head to a structured grid on the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a structured grid-like matrix of anchor nodes along the mid-lateral line.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a high-intensity upper margin and a shadowed lower margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least four smaller fish (remoras) swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface.
